name: The Doom Collection
summary:
The DOOM Collection cartridge for Evercade brings id Software's legendary first-person shooter to the platform, gathering the original games together with all of their classic expansion content on a single cartridge:

- DOOM (1993) — The original game that defined the FPS genre: fight through the UAC's Mars base and the depths of Hell itself.
- DOOM II: Hell on Earth (1994) — The direct sequel, bringing the fight back to Earth against a full demonic invasion, and introducing the Super Shotgun.
- Master Levels for DOOM II (1995) — A set of extra single levels for DOOM II, created by a mix of guest designers and originally sold as an add-on pack.
- TNT: Evilution (1996) — One of the two official Final DOOM episodes, a full 32-level campaign built by the TeamTNT community group.
- The Plutonia Experiment (1996) — The second Final DOOM episode, known for its especially high difficulty and dense monster encounters.
- No Rest for the Living (2010) — A compact 9-level DOOM II mission pack, originally created for the Xbox Live Arcade re-release.
- SIGIL (2019) — An unofficial "fifth episode" for the original DOOM, designed by original lead designer John Romero for the game's 25th anniversary.
- SIGIL II (2023) — John Romero's follow-up episode, continuing directly after SIGIL's story.
- DOOM: Deathmatch Pack — A collection of levels built specifically for multiplayer combat.

Beyond the games themselves, this release adds new gameplay modifiers (Turbo Monsters, Double Monsters, Vampire Mode), adjustable violence settings (including Shotgun Close Encounters and Chainsaw Massacre modes), three new multiplayer modes (Chaosmatch, Instagib, Tag) alongside classic Deathmatch and co-op, widescreen support, multiple soundtrack options, and scanline display effects.
